program: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) — no distinctive local nickname; Pennsylvania's own SNAP Handbook glossary uses the federal name throughout
system: eCIS (DHS's internal Client Information System, called "CIS" in older handbook text); applicants apply through COMPASS (Commonwealth of Pennsylvania Application for Social Services)

update_channels.name: SNAP Handbook — the authoritative eligibility policy source, hosted on the legacy services.dpw.state.pa.us content-management system (Adobe RoboHelp). This host serves HTTP ONLY — a direct TLS connection attempt to port 443 times out, confirmed by direct testing during this pack's build, and Pennsylvania's own current pa.gov DHS resource page links to the SAME http:// URL as its "Open Handbook" pointer. See PROVENANCE.md.
USDA FNS ABAWD Waivers FY 2025-2029 (state response documents)

verification.method: Direct HTTP fetch (curl, plain http://) of ~20 individual SNAP Handbook section pages at services.dpw.state.pa.us — the host that a prior session flagged as 'Pennsylvania is a known dead end, never attempted' turned out to be fully readable content once fetched over its native protocol; the earlier dead-end assessment appears to have come from a generic HTTPS-only fetch tool failing silently (ECONNREFUSED / connection timeout on port 443) rather than from the content itself being inaccessible. Every dollar figure and policy rule in this pack traces to a specific numbered Handbook section with its own visible 'Updated <date>, replacing <date>' issue-date stamp, not to a secondary summary. Cross-checked against a live WebSearch/WebFetch pass and against pa.gov's own current DHS SNAP pages.
verification.gates: Cross-check: every claim traced to a specific Handbook section body (with its own issue-date stamp visible in the fetched text) rather than a secondary paraphrase. Adversarial refute pass recorded in PROVENANCE.md — including a confirmed internal staleness gap (the Homeless Shelter Deduction narrative in §560.7 still shows the FFY25 figure while the FFY26 dollar table in §560 Appendix A has already been updated) and an unresolved anomaly in the FFY26 Phone/Telephone standard figure that could not be independently corroborated against a second source in this pass. `packages/snap-rules` stays fully parked per this session's standing rule — no PA StatePolicy entry exists yet (a pre-existing authoring gap, not a finding from this pack).
